activity_text: Anti-Gram+ & Gram-, Antifungal, candidacidal, Anti-MRSA, Anticancer
comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (90.48%) to Nigrocin-PN L: 33%; G: 29%, K: 14%. The two Cys in the Rana box (C-terminus) are replaced by Leu. Activity: active against Gram+5 strains S. aureus NCTC 10,788 or ATCC 25,923 or MRSA NCTC 12,493 or B038 V1S1A or B042 V2E1A (MIC 4-16 uM), E.faecalis NCTC 12,697 (MIC >512 uM), S. constellatus B003 VISIT (MIC 4 uM), Gram- E. coli NCTC 10,418 (MIC 8 uM), K. pneumoniae ATCC 13,883 or ATCC 43,816 (MIC 8-16 uM), P. aeruginosa ATCC 27,853 or ATCC 9097 or B004 V2S2B (MIC >256 uM), and fungus C. albicans NYCY 1467 (MIC 32 uM). Anticancer: H157 (IC50 24 uM), PC-3 IC50 31.27 uM0, U-251MG (IC50 25.06 uM), and MCF-7 (IC50 24.6 uM). Structure: random coil in NH4Ac and helical in 50% TFE. In vitro toxicity: ~20% hemo.lytic at 100 uM (HC50>100 uM).
reference_text: J Genet Eng Biotechnol. 2022 May 23;20(1):76. doi: 10.1186/s43141-022-00366-9. PubMed
